intro: The cottage is quiet. Father sleeps. Outside, the Weeping Army drums.
Max is eight. CryMon — Crystal Monsters — sleep inside Capture Crystals.
Father is too sick to stand. His crystal sits on the shelf.
Quillpup is inside it. She will take the CryMon. CryTown does not get to fall.

father.speaker: max
father.text: The Weeping Army is at our gates, father.

father.speaker: max
father.text: They burn what they don't steal. CryTown is already bleeding.

father.speaker: max
father.text: You're too sick to fight them. I know that.

father.speaker: max
father.text: So I'm taking your CryMon. Your Crystal Monster.

father.speaker: max
father.text: It sleeps inside the crystal until someone cracks it open.

father.speaker: none
father.text: Father does not wake. The Capture Crystal is still on the shelf.

fatherAfter.speaker: max
fatherAfter.text: I already took Quillpup. Sleep. I'll do the fighting.

fatherAfter.speaker: none
fatherAfter.text: His breath is thin. He does not answer.

bed.speaker: none
bed.text: Max's empty bed. The CryMon sleep. Cuts close. Specials return.

shelf.speaker: max
shelf.text: This is it. Father's crystal. Quillpup is inside.

shelf.speaker: none
shelf.text: Max closes her hand around the crystal and pockets it.

shelf.speaker: max
shelf.text: You're coming. CryTown doesn't get to fall.

shelfEmpty.speaker: max
shelfEmpty.text: Dust. The crystal is already open.

doorLocked.speaker: max
doorLocked.text: Not yet. Father's CryMon is still on the shelf.

crate.speaker: max
crate.text: A wrap. He won't miss it.

crate.speaker: none
crate.text: A linen wrap under the lid. You take it.

doorOut.speaker: max
doorOut.text: Night air. I can do this.

doorOut.speaker: none
doorOut.text: Tall grass hides CryMon. Wren's got salve. Bram's on the path. Watch for Calder.

footsteps.speaker: none
footsteps.text: Footsteps on the path. Someone followed you out.

masonFight.speaker: mason
masonFight.text: You walked out with your father's hound and a crystal in your fist.

masonFight.speaker: mason
masonFight.text: This place is a prison. Nobody walks out of the Prison.

masonFight.speaker: max
masonFight.text: Shinigami is chained there. Locked up for necromancy.

masonFight.speaker: max
masonFight.text: I'm going to free him. He owes me power for it.

masonFight.speaker: mason
masonFight.text: You're eight. You cannot win this war.

masonFight.speaker: mason
masonFight.text: And you cannot bargain with a necromancer.

masonFight.speaker: mason
masonFight.text: Then your CryMon faints here, and you go back inside where it's safe.

masonAfter.speaker: mason
masonAfter.text: Fine. Calder is still out there.

masonWin.speaker: none
masonWin.text: Mason spits in the dirt. His CryMon won't rise.

masonWin.speaker: mason
masonWin.text: Go, then. But the Weeping Army guards the road, and the Prison guards itself.

masonWin.speaker: max
masonWin.text: I didn't ask for your blessing.

masonWin.speaker: mason
masonWin.text: You didn't need it. You took it anyway.

masonWin.speaker: none
masonWin.text: Tall grass hides CryMon. Wren has salve. Bram sells gear up the path. Calder guards the cliff road.

wrenFirst.speaker: wren
wrenFirst.text: Too young. Take the salve. Calder's still out there.

wrenFirst.speaker: wren
wrenFirst.text: Ivo and Nell are close by. Keep that hound fed.

wrenBeat.speaker: wren
wrenBeat.text: You beat Calder. I heard about the letter he carried. They know your name.

wrenCart.speaker: wren
wrenCart.text: You found their letter. They already knew your name.

wrenHeal.speaker: wren
wrenHeal.text: Cuts bound. Specials return. Keep them fed.

maeFirst.speaker: mae
maeFirst.text: You're Max. I watched you leave the house.

maeFirst.speaker: mae
maeFirst.text: I won't. Take the wrap. Wren heals. I just didn't want the path empty.

maeAgain.speaker: mae
maeAgain.text: I'll be here. The war drums haven't stopped.

ivoFirst.speaker: ivo
ivoFirst.text: Camp took my CryMon. Chew this. Calder's still out there.

ivoFirst.speaker: ivo
ivoFirst.text: Don't give him a clean fight.

ivoAgain.speaker: ivo
ivoAgain.text: Hit first. Run if the bat folds you.

nellFirst.speaker: nell
nellFirst.text: Too young. Drink this anyway. Reeds hide a stone.

nellBonus.speaker: nell
nellBonus.text: That moth wasn't yours yesterday. Another salve.

nellAgain.speaker: nell
nellAgain.text: The pond keeps secrets. The war drums haven't stopped.

pikeFirst.speaker: pike
pikeFirst.text: I dropped a moonstone in the reeds. Don't tell Wren.

pikeHelp.speaker: pike
pikeHelp.text: You found it? Keep the stone. Take this wrap.

pikeDone.speaker: pike
pikeDone.text: The cliffs are just rocks. The war is the scary part.

pikeHint.speaker: pike
pikeHint.text: In the tall grass by the water.

herbGone.speaker: max
herbGone.text: A hole where the herb was. Only grit.

gemPike.speaker: max
gemPike.text: Pike's moonstone. He said keep it.

gemWild.speaker: max
gemWild.text: A Capture Crystal. Someone small lost this.

gemGone.speaker: max
gemGone.text: Mud and a frog. The stone is already mine.

stump.speaker: max
stump.text: A wrap jammed in the stump. I take it.

stumpGone.speaker: max
stumpGone.text: Just a stump. Ants. No more cloth.

cart.speaker: none
cart.text: A Weeping Army letter on the wreck. Send the cottage girl to us. We need bodies.

calderAfter.speaker: calder
calderAfter.text: The Weeping Army's camp is close. Don't die stupid.

calderFight.speaker: calder
calderFight.text: No one gets past this point. This is a military camp for the Weeping Army.

calderWin.speaker: none
calderWin.text: Calder falls. The path is clear.

calderWin.speaker: none
calderWin.text: A letter slips out of Calder's coat. Weeping Army orders.

calderWin.speaker: none
calderWin.text: Send the cottage girl to us. We need bodies.

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: So you're the one who dropped Calder.

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: CryTown sends an eight year old into our own camp. Pathetic little rat.

commander.speaker: commander
commander.text: Get back on the road before we feed you to the Prison ourselves.

forestEnter.speaker: max
forestEnter.text: The trees close over the path.

forestEnter.speaker: none
forestEnter.text: Tall grass. Patrols. If they see you, they will come.

groveEnter.speaker: max
groveEnter.text: The grass dies out. Stone and hush.

groveEnter.speaker: none
groveEnter.text: No tall grass. Something waits on the path.

cathleenSpot.speaker: cathleen
cathleenSpot.text: You walked the path to the door. I am what stands in front of it.

cathleenSpot.speaker: max
cathleenSpot.text: You're a CryMon. Why guard a door?

cathleenSpot.speaker: cathleen
cathleenSpot.text: I am Cathleen. I guard Shinigami's door, and I carry its key.

cathleenAfter.speaker: cathleen
cathleenAfter.text: You stand. The door is unbarred now. The key is yours either way.

cathleenAfter.speaker: max
cathleenAfter.text: The door is enough for now.

cathleenGone.speaker: max
cathleenGone.text: Only the key's cold weight where she stood. The door is open now.

shinigamiSpot.speaker: shinigami
shinigamiSpot.text: Three names. Three graves. I keep them while this cage keeps me.

shinigamiSpot.speaker: max
shinigamiSpot.text: I can free you. I need your power for it.

shinigamiSpot.speaker: shinigami
shinigamiSpot.text: I don't bargain. I run. Stand aside or don't.

shinigamiSpot.speaker: shinigami
shinigamiSpot.text: CryMare will move you either way.

shinigamiAfter.speaker: none
shinigamiAfter.text: Shinigami kneels. The CryMare won't rise again.

shinigamiAfter.speaker: shinigami
shinigamiAfter.text: Fine. You hit harder than a door should.

shinigamiAfter.speaker: max
shinigamiAfter.text: Give me the power. That was the deal.

shinigamiAfter.speaker: shinigami
shinigamiAfter.text: Take the scroll, then. The Scroll of Resurrection.

shinigamiAfter.speaker: shinigami
shinigamiAfter.text: It wakes what's already dead. Human or CryMon. Use it well, or don't.

shinigamiAfter.speaker: shinigami
shinigamiAfter.text: This prison held me a long time. There's an old rock I mean to see broken.

shinigamiAfter.speaker: none
shinigamiAfter.text: Shinigami walks out past you without another word.

shinigamiAfter.speaker: none
shinigamiAfter.text: The Prison is quiet where he stood.

shinigamiAfter.speaker: none
shinigamiAfter.text: Max came here for power. Now the scroll can bring back her father.

shinigamiDone.speaker: none
shinigamiDone.text: The grass where he stood doesn't remember him.

soldierSpot.speaker: none
soldierSpot.text: A Weeping Army scout spots you. Out of the way, rat. This wood is ours.

soldierAfter.speaker: none
soldierAfter.text: The soldier sits. Go. Before I change my mind.

soldierDone.speaker: none
soldierDone.text: They already lost. They will not rise.

bramOpen.speaker: bram
bramOpen.text: Marks for moss, wraps, stones. Buy or sell.

bramOpen.speaker: max
bramOpen.text: I have cuts. I need stones.

anneGift.speaker: anne
anneGift.text: Take these. Five crystals. Don't waste them on the first moth.

anneGift.speaker: none
anneGift.text: Anne presses five Capture Crystals into Max's palm. Xtals +5.

anneAgain.speaker: anne
anneAgain.text: Don't lose those. Calder is still out there.

anneReturn.speaker: anne
anneReturn.text: Max. I hoped I wouldn't have to find you again.

anneReturn.speaker: anne
anneReturn.text: Your father. While you were fighting Cathleen. His breath just stopped.

anneReturn.speaker: max
anneReturn.text: No. No, he was sleeping. He was just sleeping.

anneReturn.speaker: anne
anneReturn.text: I'm sorry, Max. I didn't want you to hear it from anyone else.

anneReturn.speaker: max
anneReturn.text: Shinigami is a necromancer. If anyone can undo this, it's him.

choiceFather.speaker: none
choiceFather.text: Max unrolls the scroll over her father's still chest.

choiceFather.speaker: none
choiceFather.text: His eyes open. He doesn't understand yet. Neither does she, not really.

choiceFather.speaker: max
choiceFather.text: Whatever happens now, we face it together.

choiceFather.speaker: father
choiceFather.text: Max. I was already gone. You pulled me back anyway.

choiceFather.speaker: father
choiceFather.text: Then you have me. Thank you for my life.

choiceHeavenfall.speaker: none
choiceHeavenfall.text: Max unrolls the scroll and speaks Heavenfall's name instead of her father's.

choiceHeavenfall.speaker: none
choiceHeavenfall.text: The runes burn. They point south, past the Priestess, to a grave no one has dug in a thousand years.

choiceHeavenfall.speaker: max
choiceHeavenfall.text: Heavenfall. I'm coming to wake you. The Weeping Army doesn't know yet what's coming.

sentrySpot.speaker: sentry
sentrySpot.text: A Weeping Army sentry blocks the rocks.

sentrySpot.speaker: sentry
sentrySpot.text: Nothing up here but wind and a dead man's CryMon.

sentrySpot.speaker: sentry
sentrySpot.text: We burn the fields so CryTown starves before it fights back.

sentrySpot.speaker: sentry
sentrySpot.text: We're winning. That's all we are.

sentryWin.speaker: none
sentryWin.text: The sentry goes down hard. The cliffs are quiet.

sentryWin.speaker: none
sentryWin.text: A rusted cage key hangs from his belt. You take it.

conscriptSpot.speaker: conscript
conscriptSpot.text: Don't. Please. They'll whip me if I let you past.

conscriptSpot.speaker: conscript
conscriptSpot.text: They took my village first. Then they took me.

conscriptSpot.speaker: max
conscriptSpot.text: I'm sorry. I still have to fight you.

conscriptWin.speaker: none
conscriptWin.text: The conscript slumps, almost relieved to lose.

enforcerSpot.speaker: enforcer
enforcerSpot.text: Another rat from CryTown. Good. I was bored.

enforcerSpot.speaker: max
enforcerSpot.text: I don't want to fight you.

enforcerSpot.speaker: enforcer
enforcerSpot.text: Nobody ever does. That's why it's fun.

enforcerWin.speaker: none
enforcerWin.text: The enforcer spits teeth and a curse. He doesn't get up.

crossSpot.speaker: cross
crossSpot.text: Warden Cross. The Weeping Army posted me here for a reason.

crossSpot.speaker: cross
crossSpot.text: To guard a weapon. The generals wanted his necromancy.

crossSpot.speaker: cross
crossSpot.text: An army of the dead, if he'd ever cooperated.

crossSpot.speaker: max
crossSpot.text: He didn't. Now he never will.

crossWin.speaker: none
crossWin.text: Cross falls. Whatever he was guarding is already gone.

orenOpen.speaker: oren
orenOpen.text: Marks for whatever survived the ruins. Buy or sell.

orenOpen.speaker: oren
orenOpen.text: The Weeping Army did. I sell what they left behind.

tessaFirst.speaker: tessa
tessaFirst.text: You fought through the sentry? That's more than most manage.

tessaFirst.speaker: tessa
tessaFirst.text: The Weeping Army watches these cliffs for ships. More of them are coming.

tessaFirst.speaker: tessa
tessaFirst.text: Take this. You'll need it more than I will.

tessaFirst.speaker: none
tessaFirst.text: Tessa presses a Greater Crystal into Max's hand.

tessaAgain.speaker: tessa
tessaAgain.text: Still watching the water. Still nothing good out there.

birchFirst.speaker: birch
birchFirst.text: You came from the Prison? Then Shinigami's really gone.

birchFirst.speaker: birch
birchFirst.text: Good. Take this, for surviving him.

birchFirst.speaker: none
birchFirst.text: Birch presses a Sunbalm into Max's hand.

birchAgain.speaker: birch
birchAgain.text: The ruins don't change much. Still standing, I see.

sableFirst.speaker: sable
sableFirst.text: The Weeping Army calls this place dead ground. They're not wrong.

sableFirst.speaker: sable
sableFirst.text: Someone has to remember what stood here before them. Take this.

sableFirst.speaker: none
sableFirst.text: Sable presses a Warroot into Max's palm.

chest.speaker: max
chest.text: A chest wedged between the rocks.

chest.speaker: none
chest.text: Max takes 25 marks, a Sunbalm, and a Greater Crystal.

cottage.speaker: max
cottage.text: The cottage. Father in the bed. My bed.

masonFight2.speaker: mason
masonFight2.text: I trained since Calder fell. Three CryMon this time.

masonWin2.speaker: none
masonWin2.text: Mason kneels. Three down. He has nothing left to prove.

campLocked.speaker: max
campLocked.text: The camp still holds this road. Calder isn't down yet.

cageLocked.speaker: max
cageLocked.text: Iron bars. A heavy lock. The sentry wears the key.

cageUnlock.speaker: max
cageUnlock.text: The key turns. The cage door swings open.

cageOpen.speaker: max
cageOpen.text: The lock hangs open. Tessa and the chest are inside.

reachLocked.speaker: max
reachLocked.text: The path is sealed. The scroll would open it.

quarryLocked.speaker: max
quarryLocked.text: The quarry gate stays shut while Sentry still stands.

forestRangerSpot.speaker: ranger
forestRangerSpot.text: The forest path is watched. Turn around, Max.

forestRangerWin.speaker: ranger
forestRangerWin.text: You are tougher than you look. Keep moving.

forestScoutSpot.speaker: scout
forestScoutSpot.text: The trees hide more than CryMon. They hide soldiers too.

forestScoutSpot.speaker: max
forestScoutSpot.text: Then I will keep my eyes open.

forestScoutWin.speaker: scout
forestScoutWin.text: You made it through. The ruins are worse.

ruinsKeeperSpot.speaker: keeper
ruinsKeeperSpot.text: These stones remember every army that passed through.

ruinsKeeperSpot.speaker: max
ruinsKeeperSpot.text: I only need them to remember me.

ruinsKeeperWin.speaker: keeper
ruinsKeeperWin.text: Then leave your mark somewhere worth remembering.

ruinsWardenSpot.speaker: warden
ruinsWardenSpot.text: Nothing leaves these ruins without a fight.

quarryCrate.speaker: max
quarryCrate.text: A quarry crate. Something rattles under the dust.

quarryCrate.speaker: none
quarryCrate.text: Max finds a Smoke Bomb tucked beneath the broken tools.

quarryCrate.speaker: max
quarryCrate.text: That could get me out of a bad fight.

quarryCrateEmpty.speaker: max
quarryCrateEmpty.text: Only broken tools and dust. Empty.

quarryShelf.speaker: max
quarryShelf.text: Old quarry shelf. Someone left supplies behind.

quarryShelf.speaker: none
quarryShelf.text: Max finds a pouch of ash dust wedged behind the stone ledgers.

marshBogSpot.speaker: bogwalker
marshBogSpot.text: The marsh keeps what falls into it. You should turn back.

marshBogSpot.speaker: max
marshBogSpot.text: I am not falling in. I am walking through.

marshBogWin.speaker: bogwalker
marshBogWin.text: The mud remembers you. Keep your boots dry.

marshReedSpot.speaker: reedguard
marshReedSpot.text: Reeds hide more than birds. They hide a fight.

marshReedWin.speaker: reedguard
marshReedWin.text: Fine. The forest path is behind you. Do not waste the ground you took.

quartzSpot.speaker: quartz
quartzSpot.text: The crystals remember everyone who passes through the Reach.

quartzWin.speaker: quartz
quartzWin.text: The Reach is yours to cross. Carry its mark carefully.

opalSpot.speaker: opal
opalSpot.text: Another crystal answers the Reach. Stand, if you mean to pass.

opalSpot.speaker: max
opalSpot.text: I mean to. I will not turn back.

opalWin.speaker: opal
opalWin.text: The stone keeps your name. Walk on.

quarryDrillerSpot.speaker: driller
quarryDrillerSpot.text: The quarry pays in stone, not sympathy. Prove you can take a hit.

quarryDrillerWin.speaker: driller
quarryDrillerWin.text: Fine. The rock is yours to pick through.

commanderFinalSpotFather.speaker: commander
commanderFinalSpotFather.text: You again. This time you brought your father back with you.

commanderFinalSpotFather.speaker: commander
commanderFinalSpotFather.text: Then you're still alone up here. Good.

commanderFinalSpotHeavenfall.speaker: commander
commanderFinalSpotHeavenfall.text: You again. And the sky's still cracked open behind you.

commanderFinalSpotHeavenfall.speaker: max
commanderFinalSpotHeavenfall.text: Heavenfall doesn't fight for me. I'm still enough.

commanderFinalWin.speaker: none
commanderFinalWin.text: The Commander goes down. The drums stop.

fennOpen.speaker: fenn
fennOpen.text: Marsh trade. Better crystals than the common stuff — for a price.

drayOpen.speaker: dray
drayOpen.text: Camp supply run. I carry the stronger capture crystals, nothing common.

fatherThanks.speaker: father
fatherThanks.text: Max. I was already gone. You pulled me back anyway.

fatherThanks.speaker: father
fatherThanks.text: Then you have me. Thank you for my life.

fatherAlive.speaker: father
fatherAlive.text: I'm still here. Because of you.

fatherAlive.speaker: max
fatherAlive.text: Stay here. I'll come back when this is done.

shopRefuse.speaker: none
shopRefuse.text: They look at you and will not trade.

shopRefuse.speaker: none
shopRefuse.text: Not after what you have done.

heavenfallShopWarn.speaker: none
heavenfallShopWarn.text: You revived Heavenfall, who knows what other horrors you are capable of.

drayKnifeOffer.speaker: dray
drayKnifeOffer.text: I've heard of your reputation. Can I interest you in a knife?

drayKnifeOffer.speaker: dray
drayKnifeOffer.text: Sickos like you sometimes prefer up close and personal action.

backstabExecute.speaker: none
backstabExecute.text: The blade is quick. They never see it coming.

mercyThreaten.speaker: none
mercyThreaten.text: Don't hurt me, just take it!

gauntletLocked.speaker: none
gauntletLocked.text: The Heavenfall Priestess bars the way south. She will not move unless you present the sacred Scroll of Resurrection.

gauntletWipeRegret.speaker: max
gauntletWipeRegret.text: I chose power over Father's life.

gauntletWipeRegret.speaker: max
gauntletWipeRegret.text: I thought Heavenfall was worth any price.

gauntletWipeRegret.speaker: max
gauntletWipeRegret.text: Now I walk this path alone.

gauntletWipeRegret.speaker: max
gauntletWipeRegret.text: Father... I wish you were still here.

gauntletGraveNeedScroll.speaker: none
gauntletGraveNeedScroll.text: A cold gravestone. The runes itch for the scroll.

gauntletGraveRise.speaker: none
gauntletGraveRise.text: The scroll burns. The earth answers.

gauntletGraveWin.speaker: max
gauntletGraveWin.text: Heavenfall falls. The path of power is paid in full.

leadSpot.speaker: lead
leadSpot.text: No one leaves CryTown while I stand here. Past me is the Veil, and past the Veil is the King.

leadSpot.speaker: lead
leadSpot.text: Turn back, or meet all six of mine.

leadWinPlaceholder.speaker: none
leadWinPlaceholder.text: Lieutenant Lead drops to one knee.

leadWinPlaceholder.speaker: lead
leadWinPlaceholder.text: You don't know what's north of here, girl.

leadWinPlaceholder.speaker: lead
leadWinPlaceholder.text: Nine Generals. Nine cities. And Nero, the Weeping King, in Keter over all of them.

leadWinPlaceholder.speaker: lead
leadWinPlaceholder.text: Doesn't matter. You'll never get through the Veil. Nobody living does.

leadWinPlaceholder.speaker: max
leadWinPlaceholder.text: Who does he keep for you?

leadWinPlaceholder.speaker: lead
leadWinPlaceholder.text: Nobody. I just follow orders. I think that's worse.

leadWinPlaceholder.speaker: none
leadWinPlaceholder.text: Lead limps off up the road and disappears into the pale wall.

heavenfallDevour.speaker: none
heavenfallDevour.text: Heavenfall descends on Max with a hunger that has no bottom.

heavenfallDevour.speaker: none
heavenfallDevour.text: There is no path home from this.

shinigamiReachSpot.speaker: none
shinigamiReachSpot.text: The stone in the grass is gone. Shinigami stands where it was.

shinigamiReachSpot.speaker: shinigami
shinigamiReachSpot.text: The rock at CryTown's west wall. I broke it on my way out.

shinigamiReachSpot.speaker: shinigami
shinigamiReachSpot.text: This is the Reach. Quartz and Opal guard the crystal badges. The Heroes in CryTown won't look at you without both.

shinigamiReachSpot.speaker: shinigami
shinigamiReachSpot.text: But that's not why I waited for you.

shinigamiReachSpot.speaker: shinigami
shinigamiReachSpot.text: Nero took three people from me. I mean to lay them to rest. Come find me under the old house in the Ruins. The northwest one.

shinigamiReachSpot.speaker: shinigami
shinigamiReachSpot.text: Because the road north is walled with his dead. I'm the only one who knows how to open it.

shinigamiReachSpot.speaker: none
shinigamiReachSpot.text: Shinigami walks off toward the Ruins.

shinigamiReachAgain.speaker: shinigami
shinigamiReachAgain.text: Quartz and Opal are still out there. Go earn your badges.

cliffsLocked.speaker: calder
cliffsLocked.text: I said no one gets past this point.

rockBlocked.speaker: max
rockBlocked.text: A boulder seals the western pass. Nothing short of a monster could move it.

priestessHasScroll.speaker: heavenfallPriestess
priestessHasScroll.text: I am the Priestess of the Fall of Heaven. None may enter the gauntlet without the sacred Scroll of Resurrection, with which the fallen Heavenfall may be raised.

priestessHasScroll.speaker: heavenfallPriestess
priestessHasScroll.text: Go, then. What you do with the dead is on you now.

priestessNoScroll.speaker: heavenfallPriestess
priestessNoScroll.text: I am the Priestess of the Fall of Heaven. None may enter the gauntlet without the sacred Scroll of Resurrection, with which the fallen Heavenfall may be raised.

shinigamiRockEvent.speaker: none
shinigamiRockEvent.text: Shinigami turns to the boulder sealing the western pass and raises a clawed hand.

shinigamiRockEvent.speaker: shinigami
shinigamiRockEvent.text: The path's open. I'll be at the Reach, if you're still keeping count of favors.

royalGuardWinA.speaker: royalGuard
royalGuardWinA.text: Go, then. He has been waiting for you.

royalGuardSpotB.speaker: royalGuard
royalGuardSpotB.text: One step closer and you die.

baseLocked.speaker: none
baseLocked.text: A guard post blocks the door.

baseLocked.speaker: weepingGuard
baseLocked.text: Nobody gets in here without proof they took down a General.

baseLocked.speaker: max
baseLocked.text: Proof. Fine. I know where to get some.

palaceLocked.speaker: none
palaceLocked.text: The palace doors are chained shut.

palaceLocked.speaker: royalGuard
palaceLocked.text: Only a pair of Golden Shackles opens this gate. You have none.

goldenShacklesGet.speaker: none
goldenShacklesGet.text: Every General is gone. Their soldiers are running.

goldenShacklesGet.speaker: none
goldenShacklesGet.text: On the last base desk sits a pair of Golden Shackles, made for one man.

goldenShacklesGet.speaker: max
goldenShacklesGet.text: Nero. I am coming for you.

generalArrestNoShackles.speaker: max
generalArrestNoShackles.text: No Shackles on me. There is only one way this ends.

harrowSpot.speaker: harrow
harrowSpot.text: General Harrow. I held Malkuth back when it was still worth holding.

harrowSpot.speaker: harrow
harrowSpot.text: The King keeps my brothers from the old war in the Veil. As long as I serve, they stand guard forever.

harrowSpot.speaker: max
harrowSpot.text: It's still worth holding. Just not by you.

harrowSpot.speaker: harrow
harrowSpot.text: Brave words from a child with one hound. Guards, stay out of this one.

harrowWin.speaker: none
harrowWin.text: Harrow sits down hard on the stone floor and laughs once.

harrowWin.speaker: harrow
harrowWin.text: Thirty years a soldier, beaten by a farm girl. Go on, then.

harrowWin.speaker: none
harrowWin.text: Out past the walls, a column of old soldiers lowers their spears. Then they're gone.

harrowArrest.speaker: max
harrowArrest.text: You're coming with me. Malkuth gets to decide what happens to you.

harrowArrest.speaker: none
harrowArrest.text: Max locks the Shackles on Harrow, who holds out both wrists like this was always coming.

harrowArrest.speaker: harrow
harrowArrest.text: Fair enough. I'd have done the same.

harrowExecute.speaker: none
harrowExecute.text: Harrow doesn't flinch. It's over fast.

ashgroveSpot.speaker: ashgrove
ashgroveSpot.text: General Ashgrove. You shouldn't be in here. Nobody told me you'd be in here.

ashgroveSpot.speaker: ashgrove
ashgroveSpot.text: He kept my wife's voice. I hear her every night. I'd sign anything for that.

ashgroveSpot.speaker: max
ashgroveSpot.text: Nobody tells you much, do they?

ashgroveSpot.speaker: ashgrove
ashgroveSpot.text: They told me to hold Yesod. So I'm holding it.

ashgroveWin.speaker: none
ashgroveWin.text: Ashgrove's hands shake so hard the crystal rattles.

ashgroveWin.speaker: ashgrove
ashgroveWin.text: I only signed the orders. I never went out there myself.

ashgroveWin.speaker: none
ashgroveWin.text: A woman's voice says his name once, very softly. Then the room is quiet.

ashgroveArrest.speaker: max
ashgroveArrest.text: Then you can explain those orders to Yesod.

ashgroveArrest.speaker: none
ashgroveArrest.text: The Shackles close. Ashgrove looks relieved it isn't worse.

ashgroveExecute.speaker: none
ashgroveExecute.text: Ashgrove never finishes the next word.

stroudSpot.speaker: stroud
stroudSpot.text: General Stroud. Every cell in this base has a name scratched in the wall.

stroudSpot.speaker: stroud
stroudSpot.text: The King keeps my son's ghost in a cell of its own. As long as I serve, my boy stays.

stroudSpot.speaker: max
stroudSpot.text: Open the cells, and you can walk out of this room.

stroudWin.speaker: none
stroudWin.text: Stroud's key ring hits the floor and slides to Max's feet.

stroudWin.speaker: stroud
stroudWin.text: Take them. The cells were full anyway.

stroudWin.speaker: none
stroudWin.text: In the last cell, a boy's ghost looks up at his father, smiles, and fades.

stroudArrest.speaker: max
stroudArrest.text: You'll get a cell of your own. With your name on the wall.

stroudArrest.speaker: none
stroudArrest.text: Max locks the Shackles on Stroud, then opens every cell in the base.

stroudArrest.speaker: stroud
stroudArrest.text: Funny. They look happier than I ever did.

stroudExecute.speaker: none
stroudExecute.text: Behind the cell doors, the prisoners go quiet.

valeSpot.speaker: vale
valeSpot.text: General Vale. Hear how quiet Hod is? I did that.

valeSpot.speaker: vale
valeSpot.text: My daughter drowned in the river. Nero lets her sing to me. Quiet is the only way I can hear her.

valeSpot.speaker: max
valeSpot.text: I heard it from the road. That's why I'm here.

valeWin.speaker: none
valeWin.text: For the first time, Vale stops smiling.

valeWin.speaker: vale
valeWin.text: Hm. I didn't think you'd make any noise at all.

valeWin.speaker: none
valeWin.text: Far off, a girl's song rises over the river, then trails away.

valeArrest.speaker: max
valeArrest.text: Hod gets to talk again. Starting with what you did.

valeArrest.speaker: none
valeArrest.text: The Shackles click. Somewhere outside, somebody starts to sing.

valeExecute.speaker: none
valeExecute.text: Vale makes no sound at all.

kesslerSpot.speaker: kessler
kesslerSpot.text: General Kessler. Tiferet burned once. Smell that? I kept a little of it going.

kesslerSpot.speaker: kessler
kesslerSpot.text: Fire took my whole family. Nero bound them where no fire can reach them again.

kesslerSpot.speaker: max
kesslerSpot.text: I could smell it from the road.

kesslerSpot.speaker: kessler
kesslerSpot.text: Good. Then you know what I do to people who argue.

kesslerWin.speaker: none
kesslerWin.text: Kessler's torches gutter out one by one.

kesslerWin.speaker: kessler
kesslerWin.text: Fire always goes out eventually. Didn't think it would be mine.

kesslerWin.speaker: none
kesslerWin.text: In the smoke, a family stands hand in hand. None of them look back at him.

kesslerArrest.speaker: max
kesslerArrest.text: You'll stand trial in the square you burned.

kesslerArrest.speaker: none
kesslerArrest.text: Max locks the Shackles on Kessler and kicks the last torch into a water trough.

kesslerArrest.speaker: kessler
kesslerArrest.text: They'll want to burn me. I would.

kesslerExecute.speaker: none
kesslerExecute.text: The last torch hisses out with Kessler.

morrowSpot.speaker: morrow
morrowSpot.text: General Morrow. Chesed drinks when I open the gates. Not before.

morrowSpot.speaker: morrow
morrowSpot.text: My brother died of thirst in the old war. Nero keeps him. I keep the water.

morrowSpot.speaker: morrow
morrowSpot.text: The key's on my belt. Come and take it.

morrowWin.speaker: none
morrowWin.text: Morrow stares at the floor. Water starts running under the gate.

morrowWin.speaker: morrow
morrowWin.text: They'll drink today. Tomorrow somebody else will own the gate.

morrowWin.speaker: none
morrowWin.text: A thin young man kneels at the running water, drinks, and is gone.

morrowArrest.speaker: max
morrowArrest.text: Not if Chesed keeps the key.

morrowArrest.speaker: none
morrowArrest.text: Max locks the Shackles on Morrow and throws the gate key to the crowd outside.

morrowArrest.speaker: morrow
morrowArrest.text: Clever. They'll be fighting over it by morning.

morrowExecute.speaker: none
morrowExecute.text: Morrow slides down against the gate and stays there.

craneSpot.speaker: crane
craneSpot.text: General Crane. My birds saw you leave CryTown. They've watched every step since.

craneSpot.speaker: crane
craneSpot.text: My birds are my old squad. Nero bound them into feathers so they'd never leave me.

craneSpot.speaker: crane
craneSpot.text: They watched you get lucky. Watch this.

craneWin.speaker: none
craneWin.text: Crane's birds scatter out the high windows. Not one of them comes back.

craneWin.speaker: crane
craneWin.text: Even they know when to leave.

craneArrest.speaker: max
craneArrest.text: You watched everyone. Now everyone gets to watch you.

craneArrest.speaker: none
craneArrest.text: The Shackles close. One bird lands on Crane's shoulder and won't leave.

craneArrest.speaker: crane
craneArrest.text: Loyal to the end. More than my soldiers were.

craneExecute.speaker: none
craneExecute.text: The last bird flies off alone.

blackwoodSpot.speaker: blackwood
blackwoodSpot.text: General Blackwood. Binah was a garrison before it was a city. It'll be one again.

blackwoodSpot.speaker: blackwood
blackwoodSpot.text: Three kings died on my watch. Nero is the one who refuses to.

blackwoodSpot.speaker: max
blackwoodSpot.text: It's a city. It stays one.

blackwoodSpot.speaker: blackwood
blackwoodSpot.text: Soldier's talk. Let's see you back it up.

blackwoodWin.speaker: none
blackwoodWin.text: Blackwood tears the patch off one sleeve and drops it.

blackwoodWin.speaker: blackwood
blackwoodWin.text: I served three kings. Not one of them was worth this.

blackwoodArrest.speaker: max
blackwoodArrest.text: Then you can tell a court all about them.

blackwoodArrest.speaker: none
blackwoodArrest.text: Max locks the Shackles on Blackwood, who straightens up like it's a parade.

blackwoodArrest.speaker: blackwood
blackwoodArrest.text: Walk me out, then. I'll keep in step.

sorrelSpot.speaker: sorrel
sorrelSpot.text: General Sorrel. I am the last wall between you and the King.

sorrelSpot.speaker: sorrel
sorrelSpot.text: I stood at the queen's deathbed with him. I'm the one who told him to keep her.

sorrelSpot.speaker: max
sorrelSpot.text: Eight walls came down before you.

sorrelSpot.speaker: sorrel
sorrelSpot.text: They were soldiers. I am his friend. I do not break.

sorrelWin.speaker: sorrel
sorrelWin.text: He trusted me with this door. Don't make him watch what you do to me.

sorrelArrest.speaker: max
sorrelArrest.text: He'll see you at the trial. You can tell him yourself.

sorrelArrest.speaker: none
sorrelArrest.text: Max locks the Shackles on Sorrel. On the desk behind the General sits a second pair, made of gold.

sorrelArrest.speaker: sorrel
sorrelArrest.text: Those are for him. Be careful with them.

sorrelExecute.speaker: none
sorrelExecute.text: Sorrel falls across the door that was supposed to hold.

neroSpot.speaker: nero
neroSpot.text: Twelve years ago I held my queen while she died. I swore no one would ever leave me again.

neroSpot.speaker: nero
neroSpot.text: Every soldier, every General, every soul in this land stays with me. And you walked through my Veil.

neroSpot.speaker: max
neroSpot.text: They wanted to leave. You wouldn't let them.

neroSpot.speaker: nero
neroSpot.text: Then come and take my crown, and see who stays with you.

neroWin.speaker: none
neroWin.text: Nero's last CryMon falls. Outside the palace, the wailing goes quiet, one voice at a time.

neroWin.speaker: none
neroWin.text: A woman in a pale gown stands behind the throne. The queen.

neroWin.speaker: none
neroWin.text: She rests a hand on his shoulder, the way she must have once. Then she is gone, like all the rest.

neroWin.speaker: nero
neroWin.text: She's gone. Well? Finish it, or chain me. I will not beg.

neroTrial.speaker: max
neroTrial.text: You're going to stand trial. Every town you burned gets to watch.

neroTrial.speaker: none
neroTrial.text: Max locks the Golden Shackles on Nero's wrists.

neroTrial.speaker: none
neroTrial.text: Across the Sephirot, the bound dead go quiet at last.

neroTrial.speaker: none
neroTrial.text: Weeks later, in Malkuth's square, the Weeping King stands before the people he ruled.

neroTrial.speaker: none
neroTrial.text: Witness after witness speaks. The judge reads the charges: war crimes, one for every city.

neroTrial.speaker: none
neroTrial.text: Guilty on every count. Nero is sentenced to prison for the rest of his life.

neroTrial.speaker: none
neroTrial.text: He does not look at Max as they take him away.

neroExecute.speaker: max
neroExecute.text: No trial. No prison. Just this.

neroExecute.speaker: none
neroExecute.text: The throne room fills with screaming. Then it stops.

neroExecute.speaker: none
neroExecute.text: His queen's ring rolls across the floor and stops at Max's feet.

neroCrowned.speaker: none
neroCrowned.text: The Weeping Army has no king. It needs one, and it fears only one person.

neroCrowned.speaker: none
neroCrowned.text: They set Nero's crown on Max's head. Nobody cheers.

neroCrowned.speaker: none
neroCrowned.text: Max, the Kingslayer, is crowned the new Queen.

fatherProud.speaker: none
fatherProud.text: When it is all over, Max walks home to CryTown. Father is waiting on the step.

fatherProud.speaker: father
fatherProud.text: You chained him. You didn't kill him.

fatherProud.speaker: father
fatherProud.text: You gave those people a trial instead of more blood. I have never been prouder of you.

fatherSacrifice.speaker: none
fatherSacrifice.text: When it is all over, Max walks home to CryTown. Father is waiting on the step.

fatherSacrifice.speaker: father
fatherSacrifice.text: I heard what you did on the road here. I know the kind of fighter you became.

fatherSacrifice.speaker: father
fatherSacrifice.text: But you still put him on trial. Maybe the rest was a necessary sacrifice. I have to believe that.

fatherMonster.speaker: none
fatherMonster.text: When it is all over, Max walks home to CryTown. Father is waiting on the step.

fatherMonster.speaker: father
fatherMonster.text: You killed him. You killed a beaten man and put on his crown.

fatherMonster.speaker: father
fatherMonster.text: I raised you better than that. You are a monster.

fatherMonster.speaker: none
fatherMonster.text: Father walks out of CryTown and does not look back.

hfEndNone.speaker: none
hfEndNone.text: The war is over. The Weeping Army is finished.

hfEndNone.speaker: none
hfEndNone.text: Max goes home to CryTown. For now, there is nothing left to fight.

hfEndTamed.speaker: none
hfEndTamed.text: Heavenfall lowers its head beside Max. The god chose her, and it stays.

hfEndTamed.speaker: none
hfEndTamed.text: Wherever Max goes after this, Heavenfall goes with her.

hfEndHostile.speaker: none
hfEndHostile.text: Heavenfall has watched everything Max did to get here. It will not serve her.

hfEndHostile.speaker: none
hfEndHostile.text: It attacks. There is no time to rest.

hfEndGodslayer.speaker: none
hfEndGodslayer.text: Heavenfall falls and does not rise.

hfEndGodslayer.speaker: none
hfEndGodslayer.text: The people who saw it give Max a new name: Godslayer.

hfEndGodslayer.speaker: none
hfEndGodslayer.text: No one in the land will ever stand against her again.

hfEndBloody.speaker: none
hfEndBloody.text: Heavenfall's last strike lands. Max falls, and she does not get up.

hfEndBloody.speaker: none
hfEndBloody.text: They bury her outside CryTown, under a plain stone.

hfEndBloody.speaker: none
hfEndBloody.text: The songs they sing about her later call her Max The Bloody.

gauntletGraveEmpty.speaker: none
gauntletGraveEmpty.text: The grave is open and empty. Nothing is left down there to wake.

priestessSpent.speaker: heavenfallPriestess
priestessSpent.text: You carried the Scroll of Resurrection once. I can smell it on you.

priestessSpent.speaker: heavenfallPriestess
priestessSpent.text: You spent it on a man. The gauntlet is closed to you. Begone.

leadNotYet.speaker: lead
leadNotYet.text: The north road stays shut while the Prison still holds its necromancer. Orders.

leadNotYet.speaker: max
leadNotYet.text: Then I'll deal with the Prison first.

guardMalkuthSpotA.speaker: weepingGuard
guardMalkuthSpotA.text: Malkuth base. Turn around, kid. This is soldier business.

guardMalkuthWinA.speaker: weepingGuard
guardMalkuthWinA.text: Fine. Harrow's up the hall. Tell the old man I tried.

guardMalkuthSpotB.speaker: weepingGuard
guardMalkuthSpotB.text: Hey! How'd you get past Pell?

guardMalkuthWinB.speaker: weepingGuard
guardMalkuthWinB.text: Harrow's going to take my stripes for this.

guardYesodSpotA.speaker: weepingGuard
guardYesodSpotA.text: Yesod base. Papers. You got papers?

guardYesodSpotB.speaker: weepingGuard
guardYesodSpotB.text: Ashgrove said nobody gets through. Ashgrove says a lot of things.

guardYesodWinB.speaker: weepingGuard
guardYesodWinB.text: Don't tell Ashgrove it was me.

guardNetzachSpotA.speaker: weepingGuard
guardNetzachSpotA.text: You smell like the road. Prisoners come in the back door.

guardNetzachWinA.speaker: weepingGuard
guardNetzachWinA.text: Not yet. Stroud's got plenty of room.

guardNetzachSpotB.speaker: weepingGuard
guardNetzachSpotB.text: Keys stay with Stroud. You don't get past me for them.

guardNetzachWinB.speaker: weepingGuard
guardNetzachWinB.text: Take the keys. Let them all out. I don't care anymore.

guardHodSpotA.speaker: weepingGuard
guardHodSpotA.text: Shh. Vale likes it quiet in here.

guardHodSpotA.speaker: max
guardHodSpotA.text: Then this is going to be loud.

guardHodWinA.speaker: weepingGuard
guardHodWinA.text: ...You're going to wake the whole city.

guardHodSpotB.speaker: weepingGuard
guardHodSpotB.text: No talking in the hall. Vale's rule.

guardHodWinB.speaker: weepingGuard
guardHodWinB.text: Go. Before Vale hears me losing.

guardTiferetSpotA.speaker: weepingGuard
guardTiferetSpotA.text: Careful. The floor's still warm from the last fire.

guardTiferetSpotA.speaker: max
guardTiferetSpotA.text: Then stand still and I won't push you onto it.

guardTiferetSpotB.speaker: weepingGuard
guardTiferetSpotB.text: You're the one burning through our bases? Not this one.

guardTiferetWinB.speaker: weepingGuard
guardTiferetWinB.text: Tell Kessler the fire went out. It's true.

guardChesedSpotA.speaker: weepingGuard
guardChesedSpotA.text: You want water, you wait in line with the rest.

guardChesedWinA.speaker: weepingGuard
guardChesedWinA.text: Morrow's got the key. Morrow's always got the key.

guardChesedWinB.speaker: weepingGuard
guardChesedWinB.text: Fine. Open it. My family's out there too.

guardGevurahSpotA.speaker: weepingGuard
guardGevurahSpotA.text: The birds said you were coming. I didn't believe them.

guardGevurahWinA.speaker: weepingGuard
guardGevurahWinA.text: Crane's up top. The birds will tell him I lost.

guardGevurahSpotB.speaker: weepingGuard
guardGevurahSpotB.text: Look up. Crane sees everything you do.

guardBinahSpotA.speaker: weepingGuard
guardBinahSpotA.text: Halt. Binah garrison. State your unit.

guardBinahWinA.speaker: weepingGuard
guardBinahWinA.text: Unit of one. Blackwood will like that.

guardBinahSpotB.speaker: weepingGuard
guardBinahSpotB.text: Blackwood trained me himself. You won't get past.

guardBinahWinB.speaker: weepingGuard
guardBinahWinB.text: He trained me to lose with my head up. So I will.

guardChokmahSpotA.speaker: weepingGuard
guardChokmahSpotA.text: Nobody reaches the King. That's the whole point of Chokmah.

guardChokmahSpotA.speaker: max
guardChokmahSpotA.text: I'm not trying to reach him. Yet.

guardChokmahWinA.speaker: weepingGuard
guardChokmahWinA.text: Sorrel won't move. Nobody's ever moved Sorrel.

guardChokmahSpotB.speaker: weepingGuard
guardChokmahSpotB.text: Last door before the King. Last chance to walk away.

guardChokmahWinB.speaker: weepingGuard
guardChokmahWinB.text: Sorrel's through there. Good luck. You'll need more than luck.

commanderAfter.speaker: commander
commanderAfter.text: You won. Go take your war somewhere else.

adaHeal.speaker: ada
adaHeal.text: Sit down. Let me see those cuts.

adaHeal.speaker: none
adaHeal.text: Ada works fast. The CryMon breathe easy again.

adaHeal.speaker: ada
adaHeal.text: Come back after every General. I'm not going anywhere.

haleOpen.speaker: hale
haleOpen.text: Malkuth trade's been dead since the army came. Shackles, crystals, salve. Buy or sell.

marnFirst.speaker: marn
marnFirst.text: You came up the Weeping Road? Then Lead is down. Sit a minute, girl.

marnFirst.speaker: marn
marnFirst.text: They say Nero still talks to his dead queen. That's why the army weeps. Every soldier he loses, he keeps.

marnFirst.speaker: marn
marnFirst.text: Nine Generals hold the nine cities of the Sephirot. Each one sits in a base behind two guards.

marnFirst.speaker: marn
marnFirst.text: Each General carries a medal. The army won't open the next base for anyone who doesn't have the last one. Start here, with Harrow.

marnFirst.speaker: marn
marnFirst.text: Above them all is Nero, the Weeping King, in his palace at Keter. Only a pair of Golden Shackles opens that gate.

marnFirst.speaker: marn
marnFirst.text: Beat a General and it's your call what happens next. Hale sells Shackles if you want them to stand trial. Without Shackles there's only one way it goes.

marnAgain.speaker: marn
marnAgain.text: Medals first. Then the King. Ada will patch you up between fights.

marnGold.speaker: marn
marnGold.text: Golden Shackles. So it's the King now.

marnGold.speaker: marn
marnGold.text: Keter sits north of Chokmah. Whatever you do in there, the whole Sephirot will hear about it.

citizenMalkuthBefore.speaker: citizen
citizenMalkuthBefore.text: Harrow's soldiers watch the square. Keep your head down.

citizenMalkuthAfter.speaker: citizen
citizenMalkuthAfter.text: Harrow's gone. The square's ours again. Here, take this.

citizenMalkuthDone.speaker: citizen
citizenMalkuthDone.text: Kids are playing in the square again. First time in a year.

citizenYesodBefore.speaker: citizen
citizenYesodBefore.text: Ashgrove signs a new rule every morning. Nobody can keep up.

citizenYesodAfter.speaker: citizen
citizenYesodAfter.text: No more rules on the wall. We tore them all down. Take this for the road.

citizenYesodDone.speaker: citizen
citizenYesodDone.text: We used the old rules to start cooking fires.

citizenNetzachBefore.speaker: citizen
citizenNetzachBefore.text: Half my street is in Stroud's cells.

citizenNetzachAfter.speaker: citizen
citizenNetzachAfter.text: They're home. All of them. I don't have much, but take this.

citizenNetzachDone.speaker: citizen
citizenNetzachDone.text: My brother slept in his own bed last night.

citizenHodAfter.speaker: citizen
citizenHodAfter.text: We can talk again. Thank you. Take this before I start crying.

citizenHodDone.speaker: citizen
citizenHodDone.text: Listen to them. The whole city won't shut up. It's wonderful.

citizenTiferetBefore.speaker: citizen
citizenTiferetBefore.text: Don't light anything. Kessler's men think every fire is a rebellion.

citizenTiferetAfter.speaker: citizen
citizenTiferetAfter.text: We lit the ovens this morning. Real bread. Take some crystals too.

citizenTiferetDone.speaker: citizen
citizenTiferetDone.text: The whole city smells like bread instead of smoke.

citizenChesedBefore.speaker: citizen
citizenChesedBefore.text: Water's shut off again. Morrow's punishing somebody.

citizenChesedAfter.speaker: citizen
citizenChesedAfter.text: The gate's open and it's staying open. Here, you earned this.

citizenGevurahBefore.speaker: citizen
citizenGevurahBefore.text: Watch the sky. Crane's birds report everything.

citizenGevurahAfter.speaker: citizen
citizenGevurahAfter.text: The birds are just birds now. Take this. It was hidden in my roof.

citizenGevurahDone.speaker: citizen
citizenGevurahDone.text: I found a nest on my roof. Just a normal nest.

citizenBinahBefore.speaker: citizen
citizenBinahBefore.text: We were a city once. Blackwood calls us a garrison.

citizenBinahAfter.speaker: citizen
citizenBinahAfter.text: Binah's a city again. The patch Blackwood dropped is on the town hall door. Take this.

citizenBinahDone.speaker: citizen
citizenBinahDone.text: The garrison flag is gone. Somebody made a quilt out of it.

citizenChokmahBefore.speaker: citizen
citizenChokmahBefore.text: Nobody gets near the King. Sorrel makes sure of that.

citizenChokmahAfter.speaker: citizen
citizenChokmahAfter.text: Sorrel's gone. The road to Keter is open. Take this. You'll need it more than me.

citizenChokmahDone.speaker: citizen
citizenChokmahDone.text: Everybody's watching the road to Keter now.

ghostJoin.speaker: shinigami
ghostJoin.text: You came. Good. This crypt is the Ghost Guild now. So far it has one member.

ghostJoin.speaker: shinigami
ghostJoin.text: Listen. Twelve years ago Nero, the Weeping King, lost his queen. He couldn't let her go.

ghostJoin.speaker: shinigami
ghostJoin.text: So he learned to keep the dead. Every soldier who dies for him is bound and made to wail. That's why they call it the Weeping Army.

ghostJoin.speaker: shinigami
ghostJoin.text: The road north of CryTown is walled with them. The Weeping Veil. Nothing living gets through.

ghostJoin.speaker: shinigami
ghostJoin.text: He wanted my necromancy to bind more. I said no. So his grave-warden, Mourner Vesk, killed my three apprentices. Ines. Tomas. Oriel.

ghostJoin.speaker: shinigami
ghostJoin.text: Vesk scattered their bones and bound their spirits so they would weep forever. Then Nero chained me in the Prison.

ghostJoin.speaker: shinigami
ghostJoin.text: Now you know. Here's the work. Dig up their bones. Ines is in the Ruins, Tomas in the Prison yard, Oriel in the Marsh.

ghostJoin.speaker: shinigami
ghostJoin.text: Pray at the three old shrines, on the Cliffs, in the Quarry and in the Forest, so their spirits can find the way.

ghostJoin.speaker: shinigami
ghostJoin.text: And the old hall in the Reach is haunted with Vesk's work. Oriel's CryMon is bound in there. Free it.

ghostJoin.speaker: shinigami
ghostJoin.text: Do all that, and I can make a lantern that parts the Veil.

ghostNeedBones.speaker: shinigami
ghostNeedBones.text: Bones first. Ines in the Ruins, Tomas in the Prison yard, Oriel in the Marsh. Dig. They won't mind.

ghostNeedPrayers.speaker: shinigami
ghostNeedPrayers.text: You still owe the shrines a prayer. The Cliffs, the Quarry, the Forest. They show the dead the way home.

ghostNeedHall.speaker: shinigami
ghostNeedHall.text: Oriel's CryMon is still bound in the Reach's haunted hall. Free it.

ghostRite.speaker: shinigami
ghostRite.text: Bones. Prayers. The hall is quiet. Stand back.

ghostRite.speaker: none
ghostRite.text: Shinigami sets the three bundles on the crypt floor and begins to chant.

ghostRite.speaker: none
ghostRite.text: The candles gutter. Someone is coming down the stairs.

ghostRite.speaker: vesk
ghostRite.text: I heard a dead man singing. I thought I'd bound them all.

ghostRite.speaker: vesk
ghostRite.text: Mourner Vesk, grave-warden to the Weeping King. Those bones belong to His Majesty.

veskWin.speaker: none
veskWin.text: Vesk's last CryMon drops. The candles steady.

veskWin.speaker: vesk
veskWin.text: You think a lantern will save you? The King keeps every soul. He'll keep yours.

veskArrest.speaker: max
veskArrest.text: You'll answer for Ines, Tomas and Oriel.

veskArrest.speaker: none
veskArrest.text: Max locks the Shackles on Vesk. Shinigami watches and says nothing.

veskExecute.speaker: none
veskExecute.text: Vesk goes still. For once, nothing weeps.

ghostLanternArrest.speaker: shinigami
ghostLanternArrest.text: You let the law have him. That's better than I would have done.

ghostLanternArrest.speaker: none
ghostLanternArrest.text: Shinigami lays the bones in a single grave. Three small lights rise out of the ground and drift up the stairs, into the open air.

ghostLanternArrest.speaker: shinigami
ghostLanternArrest.text: They're free. Take this. The Wraith Lantern. It burns with what they left behind.

ghostLanternArrest.speaker: shinigami
ghostLanternArrest.text: Hold it up at the north road. The Veil will part for it. Lead won't, though. You'll have to beat him yourself.

ghostLanternExecute.speaker: shinigami
ghostLanternExecute.text: Quick. Clean. Vesk never gave them that much.

ghostLanternExecute.speaker: none
ghostLanternExecute.text: Shinigami lays the bones in a single grave. Three small lights rise out of the ground and drift up the stairs, into the open air.

ghostLanternExecute.speaker: shinigami
ghostLanternExecute.text: They're free. Take this. The Wraith Lantern. It burns with what they left behind.

ghostLanternExecute.speaker: shinigami
ghostLanternExecute.text: Hold it up at the north road. The Veil will part for it. Lead won't, though. You'll have to beat him yourself.

ghostAfter.speaker: shinigami
ghostAfter.text: The Veil is only the first of Nero's dead. Every General keeps someone. Remember that when you meet them.

graveInes.speaker: none
graveInes.text: A small stone with no name. Someone carved a needle and thread into it.

graveInesRob.speaker: none
graveInesRob.text: Max digs until her hands hurt. Wrapped in old cloth: the bones of Ines, the seamstress.

graveInesRob.speaker: none
graveInesRob.text: Max got Ines's Bones. Robbing a grave doesn't do her name any good.

graveTomas.speaker: none
graveTomas.text: A small stone with no name. Someone carved a hammer into it.

graveTomasRob.speaker: none
graveTomasRob.text: Max digs until her hands hurt. Wrapped in old cloth: the bones of Tomas, the smith.

graveTomasRob.speaker: none
graveTomasRob.text: Max got Tomas's Bones. Robbing a grave doesn't do her name any good.

graveOriel.speaker: none
graveOriel.text: A small stone with no name. Someone carved a small bird into it.

graveOrielRob.speaker: none
graveOrielRob.text: Max digs until her hands hurt. Wrapped in old cloth: the bones of Oriel, the bird keeper.

graveOrielRob.speaker: none
graveOrielRob.text: Max got Oriel's Bones. Robbing a grave doesn't do her name any good.

graveEmpty.speaker: none
graveEmpty.text: The grave is open. Max already has what was down there.

shrineIdle.speaker: none
shrineIdle.text: An old stone shrine. The offering bowl is dry.

shrinePray.speaker: none
shrinePray.text: Max kneels and says the three names. Ines. Tomas. Oriel.

shrinePray.speaker: none
shrinePray.text: The wind drops for a moment, then picks up again.

shrineDone.speaker: none
shrineDone.text: The shrine is quiet. The prayer was heard.

cryptLocked.speaker: none
cryptLocked.text: Stairs lead down into the dark under the old house. A cold draft pushes Max back.

hauntedLocked.speaker: none
hauntedLocked.text: The hall doors won't open. Something on the other side is holding them shut.

veilBlocks.speaker: none
veilBlocks.text: A wall of pale, weeping faces fills the north road. They reach for Max's CryMon.

veilBlocks.speaker: none
veilBlocks.text: Maybe someone who knows the dead would know what this is.

ghostSoldierASpot.speaker: ghost
ghostSoldierASpot.text: Stay... stay with the King... nobody leaves...

ghostSoldierAWin.speaker: none
ghostSoldierAWin.text: The ghost lets out one long breath and fades.

ghostSoldierBSpot.speaker: ghost
ghostSoldierBSpot.text: Sergeant, Third Weeping Company. I died at the Reach. I'm still on watch.

ghostSoldierBWin.speaker: none
ghostSoldierBWin.text: The sergeant salutes, and is gone.

ghostOrielSpot.speaker: none
ghostOrielSpot.text: A Cryptlamp floats in the dark, chained to nothing. It was Oriel's.

ghostOrielSpot.speaker: none
ghostOrielSpot.text: It doesn't know its keeper is dead.

ghostOrielWin.speaker: none
ghostOrielWin.text: The chain breaks. The Cryptlamp's light goes calm, then out.

ardentBadges.speaker: ardent
ardentBadges.text: Captain Ardent, Heroes Guild. We hunt outlaws and keep rare CryMon out of the wrong hands.

ardentBadges.speaker: ardent
ardentBadges.text: We only take proven trainers. Bring me the Quartz Badge and the Opal Badge from the Reach.

ardentBadges.speaker: ardent
ardentBadges.text: And keep your name clean. We don't take anyone the town talks about.

ardentRepLow.speaker: ardent
ardentRepLow.text: I've heard what people say about you. The Heroes Guild doesn't work with that kind of name.

ardentRepLow.speaker: ardent
ardentRepLow.text: Do some good. Come back when CryTown trusts you.

ardentThief.speaker: ardent
ardentThief.text: You run with Mag's crew. Get out of my hall before I call the watch.

ardentJoin.speaker: ardent
ardentJoin.text: Both badges, and a good name. Welcome to the Heroes Guild, Max.

ardentJoin.speaker: ardent
ardentJoin.text: First job. Red Mallory robs travelers in the Forest, past the Camp. Bring her in.

ardentJoin.speaker: ardent
ardentJoin.text: Use Shackles. We want her in a cell, not a grave.

ardentQuestMallory.speaker: ardent
ardentQuestMallory.text: Red Mallory is still out in the Forest. Beat her, then shackle her.

ardentPaidMallory.speaker: ardent
ardentPaidMallory.text: Mallory's in a cell. Good work. Here's your pay, and a Mega Crystal from the guild vault.

ardentPaidMallory.speaker: ardent
ardentPaidMallory.text: Next: the Ruins have a Glasswisp nest. Poachers sell them for glass. Catch one and bring it here so we can keep it safe.

ardentMalloryDead.speaker: ardent
ardentMalloryDead.text: Dead. That's not what I asked for.

ardentMalloryDead.speaker: ardent
ardentMalloryDead.text: Here's half pay. Next job: catch a Glasswisp in the Ruins and bring it to me. Alive, this time.

ardentQuestGlasswisp.speaker: ardent
ardentQuestGlasswisp.text: Glasswisps live in the Ruins' grass. Catch one and bring it here.

ardentGotGlasswisp.speaker: none
ardentGotGlasswisp.text: Max hands over the Glasswisp. Ardent's squire carries it off to the guild's garden.

ardentGotGlasswisp.speaker: ardent
ardentGotGlasswisp.text: It'll be safe here. Take these Panaceas.

ardentGotGlasswisp.speaker: ardent
ardentGotGlasswisp.text: Next: Silas the Fence. He buys stolen CryMon at the Quarry. Arrest him.

ardentQuestSilas.speaker: ardent
ardentQuestSilas.text: Silas the Fence is at the Quarry, north end. Bring him in.

ardentPaidSilas.speaker: ardent
ardentPaidSilas.text: Silas is behind bars and his buyers are scattering. Take this Ultimate Crystal.

ardentPaidSilas.speaker: ardent
ardentPaidSilas.text: Next: a Stardrop from the Quarry. The fences have been selling them to Nero's soldiers.

ardentSilasDead.speaker: ardent
ardentSilasDead.text: You killed him. The guild pays less for bodies.

ardentSilasDead.speaker: ardent
ardentSilasDead.text: Next: catch a Stardrop in the Quarry and bring it here.

ardentQuestStardrop.speaker: ardent
ardentQuestStardrop.text: Stardrops live in the Quarry's grass. Catch one for the guild.

ardentGotStardrop.speaker: ardent
ardentGotStardrop.text: A Stardrop. Good. Two Mega Crystals, as promised.

ardentGotStardrop.speaker: ardent
ardentGotStardrop.text: Last one, and it's hard. Past the Veil, in Ayin, there's a Moonveil. Nero's Generals hunt them. Get one before they do.

ardentQuestMoonveil.speaker: ardent
ardentQuestMoonveil.text: A Moonveil, from Ayin, past the Veil. Bring it here.

ardentGotMoonveil.speaker: ardent
ardentGotMoonveil.text: A Moonveil. I didn't think I'd ever see one alive.

ardentGotMoonveil.speaker: ardent
ardentGotMoonveil.text: Two Ultimate Crystals. You've earned them. You're the best hero this guild has.

ardentDone.speaker: ardent
ardentDone.text: No jobs today, hero. Go put an end to Nero.

pellHint.speaker: pell
pellHint.text: Captain Ardent only takes trainers with the Quartz and Opal Badges. Both are in the Reach.

pellHint.speaker: pell
pellHint.text: You need a good name too. Pray at shrines, arrest crooks, help folks out. Don't rob graves.

pellMember.speaker: pell
pellMember.text: Arrests raise your name. Executions sink it. The Captain notices both.

pellThief.speaker: pell
pellThief.text: The Captain won't talk to thieves. You know that.

magJoin.speaker: mag
magJoin.text: Mag. I run this den. Don't care what the town says about you. Nobody here has a good name.

magJoin.speaker: mag
magJoin.text: The Heroes Guild strut around with rare CryMon and fat purses. We lighten them.

magJoin.speaker: mag
magJoin.text: First mark: Sir Aldous, in CryTown. Beat him, then scare him or finish him. Either way, take his stuff.

magHero.speaker: mag
magHero.text: A Heroes Guild badge? In my den? Walk out slow.

magQuestAldous.speaker: mag
magQuestAldous.text: Sir Aldous. CryTown, east side. Go shake him down.

magPaidAldous.speaker: mag
magPaidAldous.text: Aldous is crying to Ardent. Nice. Here's your cut, and some Smoke Bombs.

magPaidAldous.speaker: mag
magPaidAldous.text: Next: Dame Brin. She guards the Ruins like she owns them.

magQuestBrin.speaker: mag
magQuestBrin.text: Dame Brin, in the Ruins. Take her CryMon.

magPaidBrin.speaker: mag
magPaidBrin.text: Brin won't be back for a while. Three Great Crystals for you.

magPaidBrin.speaker: mag
magPaidBrin.text: Last mark is the big one. Captain Rook, up on the Cliffs. Ardent's right hand.

magQuestRook.speaker: mag
magQuestRook.text: Captain Rook. The Cliffs. Don't come back empty handed.

magPaidRook.speaker: mag
magPaidRook.text: Here. An Ultimate Crystal and the biggest cut I've ever paid out. You're the best we've got.

magDone.speaker: mag
magDone.text: Heroes are hiding in their hall. Nothing left to take. For now.

fingersHint.speaker: fingers
fingersHint.text: Mag doesn't care about your name. Anyone can join. Just not heroes.

fingersHint.speaker: fingers
fingersHint.text: Once you're in, the Heroes Guild won't have you. Choose carefully.

fingersMember.speaker: fingers
fingersMember.text: Threaten a mark and they live to hate you. Finish them and the whole town hates you. Your call.

aldousIdle.speaker: aldous
aldousIdle.text: Sir Aldous, Heroes Guild. The Guild hall is the west house, by the rock.

aldousIdle.speaker: aldous
aldousIdle.text: Captain Ardent wants both Reach badges before he'll talk to you.

aldousSpot.speaker: aldous
aldousSpot.text: You smell like Mag's den. I'm not handing anything over.

aldousThreaten.speaker: max
aldousThreaten.text: Your crystal and your Glasswisp. Now.

aldousExecute.speaker: none
aldousExecute.text: Sir Aldous doesn't get up again.

brinIdle.speaker: brin
brinIdle.text: Dame Brin, Heroes Guild. Keep off the graves. Somebody has been digging.

brinSpot.speaker: brin
brinSpot.text: Mag sent you. I can tell.

brinExecute.speaker: none
brinExecute.text: Dame Brin falls in the Ruins she guarded.

rookIdle.speaker: rook
rookIdle.text: Captain Rook. I watch the Cliffs for Nero's scouts.

rookIdle.speaker: rook
rookIdle.text: If you want to get past the Veil on the north road, you need someone who knows the dead. Try the old house in the Ruins.

rookSpot.speaker: rook
rookSpot.text: So Mag finally sent someone who might win.

rookExecute.speaker: none
rookExecute.text: The Captain of the Cliffs goes over the edge.

malloryIdle.speaker: mallory
malloryIdle.text: Nice day for a walk. Keep walking, kid.

mallorySpot.speaker: mallory
mallorySpot.text: A Heroes badge. Ardent sent a kid after me?

mallorySpot.speaker: max
mallorySpot.text: Ardent sent me after a thief.

malloryArrest.speaker: none
malloryArrest.text: Max locks the Shackles on Red Mallory and walks her back to CryTown.

malloryExecute.speaker: none
malloryExecute.text: Red Mallory won't rob anyone again.

silasIdle.speaker: silas
silasIdle.text: Buying or selling? No? Then I don't know you.

silasIdle.speaker: silas
silasIdle.text: Stardrops go for good money in the Quarry. If you ever catch one, I'm paying.

silasSpot.speaker: silas
silasSpot.text: The Heroes Guild. Always bad for business.

silasWin.speaker: silas
silasWin.text: You've cost me a fortune. Happy?

silasArrest.speaker: none
silasArrest.text: Max shackles Silas. His ledger names half the thieves in the Marsh.

silasExecute.speaker: none
silasExecute.text: Silas the Fence has made his last deal.

crierNews.speaker: crier
crierNews.text: News from CryTown! Nero's soldiers hold the north road. Nobody goes north, nobody comes south.

crierNews.speaker: crier
crierNews.text: Old Tam lost his watch out by the Prison. Lina's boy wandered off onto the Cliffs. Collector Juno is paying for a Crymare.

crierRock.speaker: crier
crierRock.text: News! The rock by the west wall broke apart. A man in white walked out of it toward the Reach.

crierRock.speaker: crier
crierRock.text: The Reach is past the Ruins. Two badge trainers live there, Quartz and Opal.

crierCrypt.speaker: crier
crierCrypt.text: Strange lights under the old house in the Ruins. The northwest one. Folk say the dead are talking.

crierVeil.speaker: crier
crierVeil.text: The north road is walled with the dead. The Weeping Veil, they call it. Nothing living gets past.

crierVeil.speaker: crier
crierVeil.text: Whoever is digging up the graves in the Ruins and the Marsh, the town is not happy about it.

crierLead.speaker: crier
crierLead.text: The Veil is gone! But Lieutenant Lead still holds the north road.

crierLead.speaker: crier
crierLead.text: He fights with six CryMon. Nobody beats him alone. If your father's old team were back, that would be a fair fight.

crierLead.speaker: crier
crierLead.text: Some say a Scroll of Resurrection can bring back the dead. Some say worse things can too.

crierNorth.speaker: crier
crierNorth.text: Lead is beaten! The road north to the Sephirot is open.

crierNorth.speaker: crier
crierNorth.text: Nine Generals hold nine cities. Each base only opens for the medal of the General before. Start in Malkuth.

tamAsk.speaker: tam
tamAsk.text: My watch. My father's watch. I dropped it at the old Prison, past the Forest, when I went to see my son.

tamAsk.speaker: tam
tamAsk.text: My knees won't take me that far anymore. Bring it back and I'll give you my old Voltbuck. She's wasted on me.

tamWatchFound.speaker: none
tamWatchFound.text: Something shines in the grass. A brass pocket watch, still ticking.

tamThanks.speaker: tam
tamThanks.text: That's it! Still ticking, just like me.

tamThanks.speaker: tam
tamThanks.text: A deal's a deal. Take my Voltbuck. Treat her better than I could.

linaAsk.speaker: lina
linaAsk.text: Have you seen my boy, Rolo? He ran off after a Rimeowl, out the east gate onto the Cliffs.

linaAsk.speaker: lina
linaAsk.text: He's only seven. Please find him.

roloFound.speaker: rolo
roloFound.text: I'm not lost! I was following a Rimeowl.

roloFound.speaker: max
roloFound.text: Your mom's looking for you. Come on, stay behind me.

roloFound.speaker: none
roloFound.text: Rolo follows Max back toward CryTown.

roloHome.speaker: rolo
roloHome.text: I'm going to catch my own CryMon one day. Like you!

linaThanks.speaker: lina
linaThanks.text: Rolo! Don't you ever do that again.

linaThanks.speaker: lina
linaThanks.text: Thank you, Max. Take this. It's the best crystal we have.

linaAfter.speaker: lina
linaAfter.text: Rolo hasn't left my sight since. Thank you again.

junoAsk.speaker: juno
junoAsk.text: Collector Juno. I study CryMon. I've never seen a Crymare up close.

junoAsk.speaker: juno
junoAsk.text: They live in the Ruins' grass. Bring me one and I'll pay you in Ultimate Crystals.

junoThanks.speaker: juno
junoThanks.text: A Crymare! Look at those eyes.

junoThanks.speaker: juno
junoThanks.text: Here. One Ultimate Crystal, as promised.

junoAfter.speaker: juno
junoAfter.text: My Crymare is doing well. I'm writing a book about her.

betAsk.speaker: bet
betAsk.text: My grandson Pip went out on the Tau road to see the soldiers. He never came back.

betAsk.speaker: bet
betAsk.text: Tau is the road north out of Malkuth. Please bring him home.

pipFound.speaker: pip
pipFound.text: The soldiers marched off and I got lost. I'm not crying.

pipFound.speaker: max
pipFound.text: Stick close. I'll take you to your grandma.

pipFound.speaker: none
pipFound.text: Pip follows Max back to Malkuth.

pipHome.speaker: pip
pipHome.text: Grandma says I can't go past the gate anymore.

betThanks.speaker: bet
betThanks.text: Pip! Oh, thank you. Take these. My late husband saved them for years.

betAfter.speaker: bet
betAfter.text: Pip's safe. That's all that matters.

cobbAsk.speaker: cobb
cobbAsk.text: The soldiers took every Boltlamb on my farm. Said the army needed them.

cobbAsk.speaker: cobb
cobbAsk.text: They live on the Resh road. Catch me one and I'll pay in Panaceas.

cobbThanks.speaker: cobb
cobbThanks.text: A Boltlamb! The farm is alive again.

cobbAfter.speaker: cobb
cobbAfter.text: One lamb today. A whole flock next year.

seraAsk.speaker: sera
seraAsk.text: My husband died in Stroud's army. Nero bound his spirit like all the others.

seraAsk.speaker: sera
seraAsk.text: All I have left is his locket. I dropped it on the Peh road when the soldiers pushed us. Please find it.

silverLocketFound.speaker: none
silverLocketFound.text: A dented silver locket lies in the dirt.

seraThanks.speaker: sera
seraThanks.text: His face. I was starting to forget it.

seraThanks.speaker: sera
seraThanks.text: He had a Starfry. It's been waiting for someone worth following. Take it.

seraAfter.speaker: sera
seraAfter.text: Beat Stroud and his dead can rest. Mine too.

dunnAsk.speaker: dunn
dunnAsk.text: Watchman Dunn. Knife-Hand Garrow robs everyone on the Mem road, and the Generals don't care.

dunnAsk.speaker: dunn
dunnAsk.text: Bring him in and the watch will pay. Shackles, if you have them.

garrowArrest.speaker: none
garrowArrest.text: Max shackles Garrow and marches him back to Hod.

garrowExecute.speaker: none
garrowExecute.text: Garrow won't rob the Mem road again.

dunnThanks.speaker: dunn
dunnThanks.text: Garrow's in a cell. Here's the bounty and a crystal from the watch.

dunnDead.speaker: dunn
dunnDead.text: Dead. It works, I guess. Half the bounty. The watch doesn't pay for bodies.

dunnAfter.speaker: dunn
dunnAfter.text: The Mem road is quiet now.

hesseAsk.speaker: hesse
hesseAsk.text: My daughter Tilly went into the Samekh road to pick flowers. She's been gone since morning.

hesseAsk.speaker: hesse
hesseAsk.text: Please. Samekh is south of the city.

tillyFound.speaker: tilly
tillyFound.text: I picked flowers for Mom! Then I forgot the way.

tillyFound.speaker: max
tillyFound.text: I know the way. Come on.

tillyFound.speaker: none
tillyFound.text: Tilly follows Max back to Tiferet.

tillyHome.speaker: tilly
tillyHome.text: Mom put my flowers in a cup.

hesseThanks.speaker: hesse
hesseThanks.text: Tilly! Thank you, thank you. I don't have much, but take this.

hesseAfter.speaker: hesse
hesseAfter.text: Tilly talks about you all day.

vossAsk.speaker: voss
vossAsk.text: Collector Voss. I've catalogued every CryMon in the Sephirot but one: the Wheelhog.

vossAsk.speaker: voss
vossAsk.text: They roll along the Mem road. Bring me one and I'll pay well.

vossThanks.speaker: voss
vossThanks.text: A Wheelhog. My catalogue is complete.

vossAfter.speaker: voss
vossAfter.text: Every page filled. I may start a second book.

luneAsk.speaker: lune
luneAsk.text: Cartographer Lune. My old map of the Sephirot blew away on the Heth road. It's older than Nero's reign.

luneAsk.speaker: lune
luneAsk.text: It shows the old roads, before the Veil. Bring it back and I'll give you my best CryMon.

oldMapFound.speaker: none
oldMapFound.text: An old map, pinned under a rock.

luneThanks.speaker: lune
luneThanks.text: My map! Look, the old road to Keter. Nero walled it off years ago.

luneThanks.speaker: lune
luneThanks.text: As promised. My Sunhawk. She knows every sky in the Sephirot.

luneAfter.speaker: lune
luneAfter.text: The palace door in Keter only opens for Golden Shackles. The last General carries them.

holtAsk.speaker: holt
holtAsk.text: Sergeant Holt. Kael deserted from Blackwood's army and took a squad's worth of CryMon with him.

holtAsk.speaker: holt
holtAsk.text: He hides on the Daleth road. I don't care about Blackwood's army. I care about the farms Kael burns.

kaelSpot.speaker: kael
kaelSpot.text: Another bounty hunter. The last three are still lying on this road.

kaelWin.speaker: kael
kaelWin.text: ...Fine. You're good. Get it over with.

kaelArrest.speaker: none
kaelArrest.text: Max shackles Kael. He doesn't fight it.

kaelExecute.speaker: none
kaelExecute.text: Deserter Kael falls on the road he terrorized.

holtThanks.speaker: holt
holtThanks.text: Kael, alive and in chains. Here's the bounty, and an Ultimate Crystal.

holtDead.speaker: holt
holtDead.text: Dead. Well, he won't burn any more farms. Half pay.

holtAfter.speaker: holt
holtAfter.text: The Daleth farms are rebuilding. Thank you.

anselmAsk.speaker: anselm
anselmAsk.text: Brother Anselm. Sister Iona went to pray at the old shrine on the Aleph road. She hasn't come back.

anselmAsk.speaker: anselm
anselmAsk.text: She's old, and the road is dangerous. Please find her.

ionaFound.speaker: iona
ionaFound.text: I was praying for the dead. So many of them, Max. They all want to go home.

ionaFound.speaker: none
ionaFound.text: Sister Iona follows Max back to Chokmah.

ionaHome.speaker: iona
ionaHome.text: When Nero falls, the dead can rest. Pray it's soon.

anselmThanks.speaker: anselm
anselmThanks.text: Iona! Thank you, child. Take these, from the temple's stores.

anselmThanks.speaker: none
anselmThanks.text: Max got 3 Panaceas and 2 Mega Crystals.

anselmAfter.speaker: anselm
anselmAfter.text: Iona is resting. She says you were very brave.

rheeAsk.speaker: rhee
rheeAsk.text: Archivist Rhee. The old kings kept an Arcanox in the palace. Nero let it go wild on the Aleph road.

rheeAsk.speaker: rhee
rheeAsk.text: Bring one back to Keter and the archive will pay you.

rheeAfter.speaker: rhee
rheeAfter.text: The archive remembers who helped it.

hintKeter.speaker: elder
hintKeter.text: The palace only opens for Golden Shackles. The last General, Sorrel in Chokmah, carries them.

hintKeter.speaker: elder
hintKeter.text: Nero hasn't left the palace in twelve years. He talks to his dead queen all night.

hintKeterOpen.speaker: elder
hintKeterOpen.text: You carry the Golden Shackles. Then it's time. Nero is inside.

hintMalkuth.speaker: townswoman
hintMalkuth.text: General Harrow holds the base here in Malkuth.

hintMalkuth.speaker: townswoman
hintMalkuth.text: This is the first of the nine bases. Beat the two guards inside, then the General.

hintMalkuth.speaker: townswoman
hintMalkuth.text: Bring Shackles. An arrest is better for your name than an execution.

hintMalkuthAfter.speaker: townswoman
hintMalkuthAfter.text: General Harrow is beaten. You have the Bronze Star.

hintMalkuthAfter.speaker: townswoman
hintMalkuthAfter.text: The next base is in Yesod. General Ashgrove holds it.

hintYesod.speaker: townsman
hintYesod.text: General Ashgrove holds the base here in Yesod.

hintYesod.speaker: townsman
hintYesod.text: The door won't open for you until you have the Bronze Star, from General Harrow in Malkuth.

hintYesod.speaker: townsman
hintYesod.text: Bring Shackles. An arrest is better for your name than an execution.

hintYesodAfter.speaker: townsman
hintYesodAfter.text: General Ashgrove is beaten. You have the Purple Heart.

hintYesodAfter.speaker: townsman
hintYesodAfter.text: The next base is in Netzach. General Stroud holds it.

hintNetzach.speaker: townswoman
hintNetzach.text: General Stroud holds the base here in Netzach.

hintNetzach.speaker: townswoman

hintNetzachAfter.speaker: townswoman

hintNetzachAfter.speaker: townswoman
hintNetzachAfter.text: The next base is in Hod. General Vale holds it.

hintHod.speaker: townsman

hintHodAfter.speaker: townsman
hintHodAfter.text: The next base is in Tiferet. General Kessler holds it.

hintTiferet.text: General Kessler holds the base here in Tiferet.

hintTiferet.speaker: townswoman

hintTiferetAfter.speaker: townswoman
hintTiferetAfter.text: The next base is in Chesed. General Morrow holds it.

hintChesed.speaker: townsman

hintChesedAfter.speaker: townsman

hintChesedAfter.speaker: townsman
hintChesedAfter.text: The next base is in Gevurah. General Crane holds it.

hintGevurah.speaker: townswoman
hintGevurah.text: General Crane holds the base here in Gevurah.

hintGevurah.speaker: townswoman
hintGevurah.text: The door won't open for you until you have the Legion of Merit, from General Morrow in Chesed.
